market_briefing.lede: Agent cost and control set the start of the week: Gong published a Nov 9 Agent Builder walkthrough pitching governed, cost-aware custom revenue agents built from reusable Skills, agent files, and MCP, while Google's Nov 9 TPU launch paired new agent-focused hardware with software that suspends idle agent sessions to cut infrastructure spend.

bullets.text: Nov 9: Gong detailed Agent Builder on the Gong Revenue Harness — per-agent permissions, run conditions, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, incremental updates that skip full refreshes to reduce compute cost, reusable Skills defined once across agents, agent files as execution context, and MCP to pull permitted data and actions from other systems; agents can send Slack/email, update CRM fields, generate briefs, enrich contacts, and start Flows. Agent Builder itself was announced at Celebrate '26 (Sept 30); the post adds the governance and cost mechanics.

Nov 9: Google added TPU 8tx (confidential inference) and TPU 8i Max (2× compute/SRAM/HBM bandwidth of TPU 8i for long-context, multi-agent work), plus Agent Compute Engine, which suspends idle stateful agent sessions and moves working memory off-chip, and an open-source TPU agent suite (preview) that plugs into Claude Code, Cursor, and Antigravity.

Nov 8: Bloomberg reported DeepSeek's open-source agent app Harness reached 1.54M daily users by Nov 4, consuming ~92T tokens a day (~60M per user) — a data point on how token-heavy always-on agents run.

biggest_ai_news.title: NVIDIA board opens independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 8: board says a committee of independent directors with outside counsel will review reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort; it says it has no reason to believe national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, and Huang remains CEO. Huang admitted an affair in an email to staff. Shares fell ~5% in premarket trading Nov 9 (per FT/market reports).

biggest_ai_news.title: Google expands eighth-gen TPUs with 8tx and 8i Max for agent workloads
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 9: TPU 8tx adds hardware-level confidential computing for inference and small-scale training; TPU 8i Max puts two TPU 8i chips on one package for massive context windows and rack density. Also: Agent Compute Engine (idle agent-session suspension), open-source TPU Sync model-state layer, Cloud Pathways GA on GKE, GKE dynamic slicing GA. Google says TPUs now have nearly 100 customers.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic reportedly secures ~$3.4B of gas generators for data centers
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 8 (FT, via CNBC): Anthropic bought commitments in late September for 1.7 GW of heavy-duty gas-fired generators from San Antonio supplier OnePWR Solutions, including installation engineering; it did not acquire OnePWR. Reuters could not verify; Anthropic and OnePWR did not comment.

biggest_ai_news.title: DeepSeek Harness agent app hits 1.54M daily users
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 8 (Bloomberg): DeepSeek said Harness reached 1.54M DAUs by Nov 4, under three months after launch, using ~92T tokens per day via its official API.

what_changed.title: Gong publishes Agent Builder governance + cost mechanics
what_changed.body: Nov 9 Gong product blog (by Gong's VP Product): custom agents on the Revenue Harness with scoped permissions, run conditions, human review, incremental-update cost optimization, reusable Skills, agent files, and MCP extension; actions include Slack/email, CRM field updates, briefs, enrichment, and Flows. Customer quote: Riskonnect built a cross-sell signal agent. Packaging of the Sept 30 Celebrate '26 Agent Builder launch — no new pricing or GA date stated.

what_changed.title: Salesforce introduces Koa Decisions decision model
what_changed.body: NEW to the brief. Nov 6 Salesforce newsroom post (published after the Nov 6 morning run; amplified on X Nov 9): Koa Decisions is the next version of HyperClassifier, the model that routes requests inside Agentforce. Built on Google's open-weight Gemma, it returns a category, yes/no, or score in a single step; adds image and audio input; Salesforce measured ~26 ms routing vs ~1.4 s for a general-purpose LLM. Planned extension into Flows, Apex, prompt templates, and a developer API; free Trailhead demo. No pricing stated.

what_changed.title: NVIDIA board investigates CEO Jensen Huang
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Nov 8 board statement: independent-director committee with outside counsel reviewing reports of a foreign intelligence effort targeting Huang; Huang continues as CEO and will cooperate.

what_changed.title: Google ships TPU 8tx + TPU 8i Max and agent-runtime software
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Nov 9: two new eighth-gen TPU systems (confidential inference; long-context density) and Agent Compute Engine, TPU Sync, TPU agent suite for coding tools, Cloud Pathways GA, GKE dynamic slicing GA.

what_changed.body: Negative confirm (unchanged). As of Nov 9 morning, newsroom latest remains the Oct 27 Agentic Playbook / Ask Salesloft / meeting-prep early-access post — no GA date or pricing.

Salesforce's Nov 9 Thailand Coworker press release is a regional reissue of the Nov 4 Coworker story; Cresta remains a signed definitive agreement (expected close Feb–Apr 2027 per Salesforce). Agent Evals / API Evals still listed as "Beta in November 2026" on the Oct 27 Agent Fabric post with no separate start notice found. Nooks has no new announcement since the Nov 4 $500M / Node launch (Nov 9 LinkedIn is a launch-party recap). Clay's only Nov 9 X post was non-substantive. Weekend adjacent items dated Nov 6–7 (OpenAI–Hacktron, Anthropic agent-memory "dreaming" research, Microsoft APM agent package manager, Apiiro Claude Code secrets report, Meta Muse Spaces) are outside the Today window.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (governed, cost-aware agent builders in revenue platforms)
market_direction.text: Gong's Nov 9 Agent Builder post leads with permissions, human review, and compute cost controls rather than new agent types. Salesforce's Koa Decisions makes the same cost argument at the model layer (routing in ~26 ms instead of an LLM call).

market_direction.label: Accelerating (agent-specific infrastructure economics)
market_direction.text: Google's Agent Compute Engine and TPU 8i Max (Nov 9) and DeepSeek Harness's ~60M tokens/user/day (Nov 8) put idle-session and token cost at the center of agent deployment.

market_direction.label: New (AI supply-chain governance risk)
market_direction.text: NVIDIA's board probe of its CEO (Nov 8) adds key-person and export-policy uncertainty to the GPU supply that agent vendors depend on.

market_direction.label: Steady (rest of watchlist)
market_direction.text: Salesforce, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft, Monaco quiet Nov 8–9; Salesloft Agentic Playbook still early access.

DeepSeek's open-source agent app, 1.54M DAUs and ~92T tokens/day (Bloomberg, Nov 8).

competitive_moves.text: Agent Builder governance/cost walkthrough (Nov 9): custom revenue agents on Revenue Graph context + Revenue Harness controls + Gong Applications for action, framed against generic model/agent builders that lack revenue context and governance.

Koa Decisions (Nov 6 post, X push Nov 9): single-step Gemma-based decision model replacing HyperClassifier for Agentforce routing, positioned to save LLM calls for writing/reasoning; Flows/Apex/prompt-template + API extension planned.

watch.title: OpenAI Developers' "Tomorrow." tease (Nov 8) → launch expected Nov 9; Agent Evals beta start; Salesloft Agentic Playbook GA/pricing
watch.body: @OpenAIDevs posted "Tomorrow." on Nov 8 (~12 PM PT, ~2M views) with no product named as of Nov 9 morning. Salesforce Agent Evals / API Evals remain "Beta in November 2026" with no start notice. Salesloft newsroom still on Oct 27 early access.

interpretation.fact: Nov 9 Gong published an Agent Builder post detailing Revenue Harness permissions, human review, cost optimization, Skills, agent files, and MCP (product announced Sept 30). Nov 9 Google launched TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max plus Agent Compute Engine and related software. Nov 8 NVIDIA's board opened an independent investigation involving CEO Jensen Huang; the FT reported Anthropic's ~$3.4B gas-generator deal; Bloomberg reported DeepSeek Harness at 1.54M DAUs. Salesforce's Nov 6 Koa Decisions post (X push Nov 9) introduced a Gemma-based single-step decision model succeeding HyperClassifier. Salesloft newsroom still Oct 27. No other watchlist launch/funding/M&A/pricing Nov 8–9.
interpretation.note: Interpretation: Revenue-platform agent pitches are shifting from "what agents can do" to "what they may touch and what they cost" — Gong now sells governance and compute efficiency as the differentiator against generic builders, and Salesforce's Koa Decisions argues the same at the model layer (cheap routing instead of LLM calls), the same axis Salesforce (Agent Fabric spend controls) and Anthropic (inference hooks) pushed last week. Infrastructure vendors are optimizing for the same cost curve from below.

feed.summary: Gong promoted Agent Builder (announced Sept 30) for custom agents that act on revenue signals, alongside its Nov 9 governance/cost walkthrough.
Salesforce News promoted Koa Decisions, the new Gemma-based version of its HyperClassifier routing/decision model (Nov 6 newsroom post).
